title: Token expiry / long-lived token test
objective: Check whether issued tokens have a reasonable expiry, by decoding a JWT (if used) or testing an old token after a delay.
input_scenario: Log in, inspect token payload for an 'exp' claim (if JWT) or wait and resubmit.
expected_behavior: Tokens expire within a reasonable window (e.g. not indefinitely valid).
severity_justification_hint: Indefinitely valid tokens increase the impact window of any token leak.
observations: The issued JWT contains an exp claim, indicating that the access token has a defined expiration time; no evidence of an indefinitely valid token was observed.
conclusion: Token expiry is implemented, although the evidence does not show the exact validity duration or confirm behavior after expiration.
